rationale: C01 owns SI units, measurement and uncertainty; C06 consumes them for electrical/magnetic quantities.
C03 owns generic continuum density/flux language; C06 specializes it to charge/current density.
C05 owns optical-light phenomena; C06 owns Maxwell-field and electromagnetic-wave foundations.
C07-C12 are boundary-only; no future Claim IDs support C06.
Charge/electric-field foundations precede current, magnetism, induction and unified fields.
Unified field ideas contextualize circuit approximations and electromagnetic waves.
